requirements.text: Any payment features must adhere to PSD2's strong customer authentication protocols, implementing robust authentication methods for transactions and sensitive account access.
The app must ensure that any customer data shared, particularly in real-time notifications, is handled appropriately and in compliance with GDPR regulations.
All new functionalities, including customer-managed card settings, must align with consumer protection guidelines set by the Central Bank of Ireland.
New features must integrate with the existing core banking system without requiring significant modifications.
A step-by-step approach will be taken to assess the feasibility of new features within the regulatory framework before pursuing more ambitious functionalities.
